Inspect every frozen diagnostic and turntable frame against references; silhouette, construction, proportions and materials must meet the brief. Required: Single narrow gently curved Cloudina skeletal tube fragment composed of nested eccentric funnel-like collars with flaring margins; Continuous open lumen, thin full-volume carbonate wall and two visibly incomplete broken ends; no complete basal apex asserted; Not whole living animal, reef colony, soft tissue reconstruction, detached stack of cups or segmented worm. Scope: Original genus-level Cloudina fossil-skeletal-fragment study, consistent with original fossil-specimen inventory. Primary Wood,Ivantsov,Zhuravlev2017 Fig2b skeletal specimen photograph by Shuhai Xiao informs nested eccentric funnels; not photo replica, scan, species/locality-specific specimen or whole living organism. Two broken ends intentionally bound a fragment and do not assert natural open basal apex. Nominal12mm fragment length and3.5mm approximate maximum width illustrative, not source measurement. Pale carbonate color, posture and hidden inner surface simplified artistic choices; exact micrometre laminae not resolved. Whole-animal affinity and life position remain uncertain.

concept_decisions: Concept correctly shows single curved hollow nested funnel construction, but exaggerates thick chalk texture and flare size; simplify texture to palette-only facets, reduce chunky wall and taper, retain continuous thin wall and visible lumen. Use about14 uneven mildly eccentric collars along a gentle curve, not separate intersecting rings or hollow cups stacked with gaps. Ends broken with modest uneven edge, no invented basal holdfast, tentacles, organism or reef. Final orientation upright fragment is presentation only, not ecological life-position claim.
